speaker: agent
text: Before I suggest anything — who all depend on your income right now?

speaker: customer
text: Wife, two kids. My mother also stays with us.

speaker: agent
text: And if that income stopped for six months... what happens?

speaker: customer
text: Honestly? We would be in trouble by month two.

speaker: agent
text: Then that is what we fix first. Do you have any cover today?

speaker: customer
text: One LIC policy from years ago. I do not even know what it covers.

speaker: agent
text: Most people do not — let us find out what you have before we add anything new.
